-- What a client importing `GooseLang.Ext.AbsDisk.Impl` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def Perennial.instCountableHardStateM_gooseLang : Pos.Countable HardStateM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun h => Pos.Countable.encode (h.Term', h.Vote', h.Commit'))
    instCountableHardStateM_gooseLang._proof_1

def Perennial.instCountableConfStateM_gooseLang : Pos.Countable ConfStateM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun c => Pos.Countable.encode (c.Voters', c.Learners', c.VotersOutgoing', c.LearnersNext', c.AutoLeave'))
    instCountableConfStateM_gooseLang._proof_1

def Perennial.absDiskUpd (s : AbsDiskState) (dir : GoString) (f : WalDur → WalDur) : AbsDiskState :=
  match s.wal !! dir with
  | some d => { area := s.area, wal := <[dir := f d]>s.wal, dirs := s.dirs }
  | none => s

def Perennial.AbsDiskStep [GoGlobalContext] (op : String) (v : val) (h : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val))
    (s : AbsDiskState) (_g : Unit) (e' : Expr) (h' : GMap Loc (NonAtomic val)) (s' : AbsDiskState)
    (_g' : Unit) : Prop :=
  h' = h ∧
    e' = Val (intoVal ()) ∧
      match op with
      | "WalCreate" =>
        ∃ dir md,
          v = (intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal md) ∧
            walAreaDir s.area dir ∧
              (∀ (k : GoString), walCreateRegion dir k → s.wal !! k = none) ∧
                s' = { area := s.area, wal := <[dir := walDurFresh md]>s.wal, dirs := s.dirs }
      | "WalNamed" =>
        ∃ dir,
          v = intoVal dir ∧
            s' =
              absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := true,
                  sized := d.sized }
      | "WalAppend" =>
        ∃ dir o,
          v = (intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode o)) ∧
            s' =
              absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                { H := d.H ++ [o], m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata,
                  named := d.named, sized := d.sized }
      | "WalSync" =>
        ∃ dir n,
          v = (intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode n)) ∧
            (∀ (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → n ≤ d.H.length) ∧
              s' =
                absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                  { H := d.H, m := max d.m n, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata,
                    named := d.named, sized := d.sized }
      | "WalUnlock" =>
        ∃ dir p,
          v = (intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode p)) ∧
            s' =
              absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := max d.unl p, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata,
                  named := d.named, sized := d.sized }
      | "WalPurge" =>
        ∃ dir k,
          v = (intoVal dir).PairV (intoVal (walCode k)) ∧
            (∀ (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → d.cut ≤ k ∧ k ≤ max d.pur d.unl) ∧
              s' =
                absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                  { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := max d.pur d.unl, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata,
                    named := d.named, sized := d.sized }
      | "WalUnsize" =>
        ∃ dir,
          v = intoVal dir ∧
            s' =
              absDiskUpd s dir fun d =>
                { H := d.H, m := d.m, unl := d.unl, pur := d.pur, cut := d.cut, metadata := d.metadata, named := d.named,
                  sized := false }
      | "DirDurable" =>
        ∃ d, v = intoVal d ∧ ¬underDir s.area d ∧ s' = { area := s.area, wal := s.wal, dirs := <[d := ()]>s.dirs }
      | x => False

def Perennial.walImg {E : Type} (H : List (WalOpG E)) (n : Nat) (I : List (WalOpG E)) : Prop :=
  ∃ j,
    n ≤ j ∧
      j ≤ H.length ∧
        (I = List.take j H ∨
          ∃ h es k,
            H[j]? = some (WalOpG.save h es) ∧
              k ≤ es.length ∧
                I = List.take j H ++ [WalOpG.save { Term' := 0, Vote' := 0, Commit' := 0 } (List.take k es)])

def Perennial.walDurFresh (md : List w8) : WalDur :=
  { H := [], m := 0, unl := 0, pur := 0, cut := 0, metadata := md, named := false, sized := true }

def Perennial.absDiskInitOk (s : AbsDiskState) : Prop :=
  cleanAbsPath s.area ∧
    (∀ (k : GoString) (d : WalDur), s.wal !! k = some d → walAreaDir s.area k) ∧
      ∀ (k : GoString), s.dirs !! k = some () → cleanAbsPath k ∧ ¬underDir s.area k

theorem Perennial.walCode_inj {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] {a b : A} (h : walCode a = walCode b) : a
    = b

def Perennial.walCode {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (a : A) : GoString :=
  List.replicate (Pos.Countable.encode a).toNat 0

def Perennial.instCountableWalOpG {E : Type} [Pos.Countable E] : Pos.Countable (WalOpG E) :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun o =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        (match o with
        | WalOpG.save h es => Sum.inl (h, es)
        | WalOpG.snap m => Sum.inr m))
    ⋯

def Perennial.instInhabitedAbsDiskState : Inhabited AbsDiskState :=
  { default := { area := [], wal := ∅, dirs := ∅ } }

def Perennial.absDisk_semantics : ExtSemantics absDiskExt :=
  { step := fun [GooseExts] [GoGlobalContext] => AbsDiskStep,
    crash := fun s s' =>
      s'.area = s.area ∧
        s'.dirs = s.dirs ∧
          (∀ (dir : GoString) (d : WalDur), s.wal !! dir = some d → walCrash d (s'.wal !! dir)) ∧
            ∀ (dir : GoString), s.wal !! dir = none → s'.wal !! dir = none }

structure Perennial.WalDur : Type where
  H : List (WalOpG WalEnt)
  m : Nat
  unl : Nat
  pur : Nat
  cut : Nat
  metadata : List w8
  named : Bool
  sized : Bool

inductive Perennial.WalOpG (E : Type) : Type
  | Perennial.WalOpG.save {E : Type} (h : HardStateM) (es : List E) : WalOpG E
  | Perennial.WalOpG.snap {E : Type} (m : SnapshotMetadataM) : WalOpG E

structure Perennial.AbsDiskState : Type where
  area : GoString
  wal : GMap GoString WalDur
  dirs : GSet GoString

def Perennial.absDiskExt : GooseExt :=
  { name := "go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3/storage/wal", Val := Empty, LocalState := AbsDiskState, GlobalState := Unit,
    val_countable := countableEmpty, localState_inhabited := instInhabitedAbsDiskState,
    globalState_inhabited := instInhabitedPUnit }

structure Perennial.WalEnt : Type where
  term : w64
  index : w64
  typ : w32
  data : List w8

def Perennial.instCountableSnapshotMetadataM_gooseLang : Pos.Countable SnapshotMetadataM :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun m => Pos.Countable.encode (m.ConfState', m.Index', m.Term'))
    instCountableSnapshotMetadataM_gooseLang._proof_1

def Perennial.instCountableWalEnt : Pos.Countable WalEnt :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun e => Pos.Countable.encode (e.term, e.index, e.typ, e.data)) instCountableWalEnt._proof_1

def Perennial.walCrash (d : WalDur) (d' : Option WalDur) : Prop :=
  d.named = false ∧ d' = none ∨
    ∃ I k,
      walImg d.H d.m I ∧
        k ≤ min d.pur I.length ∧
          d' =
            some
              { H := I, m := d.m, unl := min d.unl I.length, pur := min d.pur I.length, cut := k, metadata := d.metadata,
                named := d.named, sized := d.sized }
